summary: Verified the installed mj2 closure before writing code. Two of the five demands contradict the packet. Demand 3: only 1 of 9 style imports is blocked by the ng-zorro 16 exports map (the root style/index.min.css); the other 8 resolve, and the map exposes no narrow equivalent for the blocked one — only the 550KB whole-library aggregate, a payload change that lands in the parity inventory. Demand 5: nzData is injector-provided via NZ_MODAL_DATA, never assigned to the instance, so a call-site-only rewrite compiles green but silently kills three component fields; a cross-module content-component rewrite is required. Demand 2 also needs cross-literal option relocation. Honest cut line exceeds this unit. No files written.
open_questions: Demand 3: ng-zorro-antd@16.2.2 exports no equivalent for the blocked ./style/index.min.css — only root aggregates that are a different build (entry bytes are not a substring of the aggregate). Should the capability rewrite entry -> ./ng-zorro-antd.min.css (22.7KB -> 550KB CSS, and the 8 granular imports become redundant) and record it as a declared difference plus a parity non-claim? Or should it refuse and the blocked import be answered another way? A generic exports-map transform cannot choose this on its own.

Demand 5: completing the nzComponentParams -> nzData migration requires a second, cross-module capability that resolves the nzContent class binding to its declaring module and rewrites IssueModalComponent (@Input() issue$) and IssueDeleteModalComponent (issueId, onDelete EventEmitter) to read NZ_MODAL_DATA. Confirm that capability is in scope, or the modal transform must refuse and the build stays red.

Demand 2: tracingOrigins has no v8 integration-level counterpart; tracePropagationTargets is a Sentry.init client option. Confirm the Sentry capability may relocate a property from the integration options literal into the enclosing init options literal (refusing if the init call cannot be binding-resolved or already declares the name), rather than dropping tracingOrigins as a declared difference.

Given the three expansions above plus demand 4 and the build/parity/test/evidence work, is this best re-cut as: (a) Sentry v8 capability + tests, (b) ng-zorro peer-hole + exports-map style capability + tests, (c) modal call-site + content-component capability + tests, (d) apply + x2 builds + parity evidence?
